title: Barry Blitt’s “Pulling the Plug”
excerpt: Françoise Mouly speaks with the cartoonist Barry Blitt about his cover for the September 28, 2026, issue of The New Yorker.
content_html:
Is an A.I. kill switch possible?

September 21, 2026

For the cover of the September 28, 2026, issue, the cartoonist Barry Blitt portrays the rising fears surrounding the exponential growth of A.I. and the possibility of its being a threat to humanity. “As a dedicated hypochondriac, I’ve had a number of pretty good conversations with Google’s Gemini chatbot, about all manner of ailments. But I understand that A.I. may not always be looking out for my well-being,” Blitt said.

Barry Blitt, a cartoonist and an illustrator, has contributed to The New Yorker since 1992. In 2020, he won the Pulitzer Prize for editorial cartooning.
